symmetry_fold — DRIVE pegsym op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.symmetry_fold(angle: 'float', n: 'int') -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsym; pegsym.symmetry_fold(angle: 'float', n: 'int') -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("symmetry_fold"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

角を n 回対称の商 SO(2)/C_n の代表 (−π/n, π/n] に畳む(n = 1 は (−π, π]、n = 0 = 円は 0)。群の恒等式 symmetry_fold(α + 2πk/n, n) = symmetry_fold(α, n) が門。Raises ValueError: n < 0、角が有限でない。
